result:
Verdict: **FAIL** for DG0 round 4, candidate `sha256:0be571ea…a3b7` at commit `53f5d176`. One High mandatory finding from earlier rounds is still open. The other 16 earlier findings are fixed.

Before reviewing I confirmed the candidate: HEAD is a later metadata-only commit, and the recomputed candidate ID matches. I checked it again at the end, after another reviewer's auto-commit moved HEAD, and it was unchanged. I didn't open any other round-4 review record.

**Re-checking my 17 earlier findings.** For each one I reproduced the original failure on the commit it was raised against (26642c7, 83860be, 540b3c6), then tested it on the new candidate.
- **Fixed (16):** F-DG0-101 to 114, 116 and 117 are recorded as `CLOSED_VERIFIED`.
- **Still open (1): F-DG0-115, High, mandatory violation.** The new check that committed review evidence is never changed doesn't look inside merge commits. The validator uses `git log --diff-filter=MDT` without merge diffs, so git prints nothing for them.
  - In a disposable copy, I committed a reviewer's genuine FAIL verification of a High finding, then rewrote it as a closure inside a merge commit.
  - The gate passed in current mode, in historical mode after approval, and in the pipeline check.
  - A committed High finding can be dropped the same way.
  - Adding `-m` to the same command reveals the change.
  - The fix is to include merge diffs, or better, to compare each file with the version first committed. The real DG0 history has no merges and no changed evidence, so a correct rule wouldn't block DG0.

**New findings (all Low, none a mandatory violation, all owned by delivery-orchestrator):**

| ID | Problem | How it was shown |
|---|---|---|
| F-DG0-118 | Marking committed files `skip-worktree` hides local tampering from the "no uncommitted edits" check, and a forged closure then passes. This only affects local validation, since CI checks out committed content. | Reproduction test 13 |
| F-DG0-119 | The runner records any bytes present when a run ends, at any path the agent *tried* to write, even when the write guard denied the write. So another writer's bytes get bound and committed as the reviewer's. The docs (decision D-021 and `agent-protocol.md`) wrongly say "exact bytes your run wrote". | Real runner with a stub `claude` in a disposable clone. My own round-3 history shows the same thing harmlessly: my run later edited its findings file with `sed`. |
| F-DG0-120 | The runner's auto-commit passes written paths to git unquoted. A path containing `*` swept an unrelated modified file into the reviewer's commit. `\|\| true` hides any commit failure. | Stub-runner run |
| F-DG0-121 | The gate record's content isn't tied to the auditor's run; only its invocation reference string is compared. Its `tests[]` list can be replaced with fabricated entries and the gate still passes. | Reproduction test 20 |

**Everything else passed:**
- The candidate's own tests: 42 of 42.
- Write guard, probed through the real hook commands: nested `.git`, `..`, case tricks, symlinks, MultiEdit/NotebookEdit and garbage input are all blocked. It fails closed when `git` or `node` is missing. My first missing-`git` probe was invalid and is corrected in the log.
- The candidate ID stays the same with Windows-style line-ending conversion and with `core.fileMode=false`.
- CI pins its actions to commit SHAs, has read-only permissions and a full-history checkout, and fails the job on a failed gate.
- Runner argument injection is rejected, and the agent's exit code comes back correctly.
- No credentials or personal data were found in the repository or in run transcripts.
- The validators and the extraction check give the expected results. `--stage DG0` fails, correctly, because there's no gate record yet.

Requirements verified: REQ-DLV-006, 007, 013, 015, 016, 017, 022, 023 and 026. My disposable worktrees and clones are removed; the qa-verifier's worktrees were left alone.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`. All three validate against their schemas:
- `reviews/DG0/round-4/code-security-reviewer.json` (the record)
- `reviews/DG0/round-4/code-security-reviewer.findings.json`
- `reviews/DG0/round-4/code-security-reviewer.verifications.json` (17 entries)

The reproduction scripts and logs are in `test-evidence/DG0/code-security/round-4/`, starting with `repro-r4.test.mjs` and `06-runner-e2e.log`.
